|errata_history={{Card errata/Your Insight Serves You Well (Reflections III) (V)}}
This is the original printed text of [[Your Insight Serves You Well (Reflections III) (V)]] (version 1 of 3). The image here is the PC card image of this printing (published 8 July 2018); the PC first published the printing as a slip in its Virtual Card Master Set (August 2016). The current text is [[Your Insight Serves You Well (Reflections III) (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every publication that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026); the printed errata mark counts changes to the words instead, so it can be lower than the version number.
* '''Original''' (this page): Slip in the PC's Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0), official text as of 1 August 2016<ref name="ms2016">Players Committee, Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0) PDF <code>Set-0.pdf</code>, “Official text as of August 1, 2016” (file created 2 August 2016), page 11, slip “•Your Insight Serves You Well (Reflections III) (V)” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 6 August 2016]).</ref>: “Plays on table. Scanning Crew is canceled. If an ‘insert’ card was just inserted or revealed, it is canceled. You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. While you occupy three battlegrounds, Watto's Box is suspended.” Printed: a partial slip (the “DEFENSIVE SHIELD” band and the game-text box only), to be laid over the Decipher card; lower-left name “•Your”; no errata mark. The PC first released this card with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014; the slips of that first release do not survive in the Internet Archive, so this sheet is the earliest surviving text. The PC re-issued the PDF on 30 May 2017 with this slip unchanged (pixel-identical)<ref name="ms2017">The same PDF re-issued by the PC (file created 30 May 2017), page 9 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 4 July 2017]).</ref>. The PC's full card image of this printing was first published on 8 July 2018<ref name="v1-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Light/large/yourinsightservesyouwell.gif yourinsightservesyouwell.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b 022435b] (8 July 2018, “Set 9 load”).</ref> ([[:File:VD-L-yourinsightservesyouwell-2018-07-08.gif]]): the slip is the lower part of the same card render (same frame, typesetting, line breaks and lower-left name), with the same words. A same-words slip that reprints a card image is a note on that version, not a separate version (Bill, 17 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Your Insight Serves You Well (Reflections III) (V) (Errata)]]): Card image published 31 July 2022<ref name="v2-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Light/large/yourinsightservesyouwell.gif yourinsightservesyouwell.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab74419 ab74419] (31 July 2022, “updated hires gifs”); high-resolution image <code>ResetDS-Light/hires/yourinsightservesyouwell.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/594c3a0 594c3a0] (31 July 2022, “Set 0 Hi Res”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Scanning Crew is canceled. If an ‘insert’ card was just inserted or revealed, it is canceled. You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. While you occupy three battlegrounds, Watto's Box is suspended.” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “Your Insight Serves You Well (Reflections III)”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' re-rendered by the PC in its high-resolution card style (new frame, colours and typesetting); same words (new line breaks). The lower-left name changes from “•Your Insight Serves You Well” to “Your Insight Serves You Well (Reflections III)”. No errata mark.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Your Insight Serves You Well (Reflections III) (V) (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 22 July 2024<ref name="v3-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/6c22b092dca1396fcd637dae561b4b951698a640/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Light/large/yourinsightservesyouwell.gif yourinsightservesyouwell.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6c22b09 6c22b09] (22 July 2024, “Fixing case and making gifs”); high-resolution image <code>ResetDS-Light/hires/yourinsightservesyouwell.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a546b30 a546b30] (21 July 2024, “Set 23 Errata”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Cancels Scanning Crew and ‘insert’ cards just revealed. Sidious may not place Skywalkers out of play. Let Them Make The First Move may target only Undercover spies. Unless Inner Strength on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn.” Printed: marked “E1”; lower-left name “Your Insight Serves You Well (Reflections III)”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1”: the first change to the words. '''What changed:''' PC errata released with [[Virtual Set 23]] and the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit<ref name="dskit2024">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file built 2 August 2024), released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024).</ref> (image marked “E1”): the whole game text after “Plays on table.” is replaced: “Cancels Scanning Crew and ‘insert’ cards just revealed. Sidious may not place Skywalkers out of play. Let Them Make The First Move may target only Undercover spies. Unless Inner Strength on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn.” (the Boonta Eve Podrace and Watto's Box sentences are removed; the Sidious, Let Them Make The First Move and Inner Strength sentences are new). On 2 August 2024 the PC also printed this image in the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit<ref name="dskit2024-slip">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024), page 2: partial slip labelled “•Your Insight Serves You Well (Reflections III)”. Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF itself is dated by its creation date.</ref> ([[:File:VD-L-yourinsightservesyouwell-2024-08-02-kit-slip.png]]) as a partial slip (the “DEFENSIVE SHIELD” band and game-text box, down to the lower-left name and the mark “E1”), cut from this card image with the same words. A same-words slip that reprints a card image is a note on that version, not a separate version (Bill, 17 November 2026).
